admission.justification: The per-voice and selection proofs guard omission or substitution of an individual entry rationale while keeping copied authored text stable.

applicability: Entry introductions of the review page code cards, including cards drawing several entries.
conditions: A line names the entry id, its authored rationale or facet, invariant, role/facet label and available planning mark; missing authored text is a named gap.
Added/retired/revised badges remain beside the line; a revised entry keeps its earlier rationale as its own Before line.
A click orEnter/Space opens only that line in place; completing a text selection does not toggle it.
Resolved duplicate range lines may be visually hidden for screen readers only when the excerpt supplies both resolved ranges; unresolved side reasons remain visible.
exclusions: Inventing rationale/facet text for a missing author field.
Collapsing multiple entry voices to a single lead rationale.
Using boxed native buttons that prevent the introduction text from being selected.
